svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin; Mobile: React Native, Android (native Android in Kotlin and Java); Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, FastAPI; Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind; Data: Postgres, Redis, MongoDB, SQLite, Prisma; Tooling: Docker, Vitest, Jest (Playwright · Asterisk (ARI/PJSIP) · Turborepo · pnpm); AI / ML: PyTorch, scikit-learn, TensorFlow (Gemini · Deepgram · Google Cloud TTS · sentence-transformers); E-commerce: (Shopify)
